message: You know that feeling when the weather man says "snow" and you suddenly become a gloriously over-prepared squirrel? 🐿️ I love having a plan for winter weather, and this resource is a treasure trove of tips to keep your home cozy and safe when Mother Nature decides to throw a tantrum. Just remember, even if you have enough supplies to last through an ice age, a good book and a cup of tea can be the best comforts of all!
